title: L4 review report (human / agent semantic-visual review)
_comment: Stage product of the L4 review (skills/09 VAL-01, skills/10 anti-PPT, skills/coordinator step 8). L4 may NEVER be machine-faked: every verdict starts PENDING and may only be set PASS/FAIL by a human or agent who has actually looked at the preview frames. This schema makes the review report machine-checkable so the no-fake invariant is enforceable.

l4_status.description: PENDING until every case has a non-PENDING verdict and a named reviewer.

reviewer.description: Human or agent identity that performed the review; null while PENDING.
